program_note:
Zachor (memory) depicts the emergence of an old klezmer tune from the haze of distant memory, as if it were nearly forgotten.  As the haze dissipates the tune itself (a Jewish dance tune from Lithuania) becomes clearer, until it ultimately submerges back into the fog of memory.

Zachor was written for Misha Rachlevsky and the Russian String Orchestra.  It is about 10 minutes in duration.

David S. Lefkowitz
Los Angeles, CA
31 July, 2017
